profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Newton MRT about 540 m, Somerset MRT about 750 m; closer than 159 of 551 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Junior) about 250 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 580 m), more than 344 of 551 similar developments (the same as 74); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 500 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 810 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 870 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 980 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,110 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,120 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,240 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,340 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,420 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,440 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 499 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,372 new sales and 1,370 resales (2,742 purchases); new sales were 50% of these purchases. Subsales (60) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,370 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 537 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,370 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,477 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.2%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
